interpretations: For each site with matching processing records, group by site code and insurance status; calculate the average nonmissing `remaingb` and the average nonmissing row-level `ABS(proccpu - procgpu)`; divide the group’s average `remaingb` by the mean of all nonmissing group averages; return no rows if that mean is missing; sort by the ratio descending with missing ratios last; return the first 10 rows without rounding.
queries:
WITH site_groups AS (
    SELECT
        s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
        s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
        AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaingb,
        AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_difference
    FROM sites AS s
    JOIN scanprocessing AS p
        ON p.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
    GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
group_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_remaingb) AS mean_avg_remaingb
    FROM site_groups
)
SELECT
    g.site_code,
    g.insurance_status,
    g.avg_remaingb,
    g.avg_cpu_gpu_difference,
    g.avg_remaingb / m.mean_avg_remaingb AS ratio
FROM site_groups AS g
CROSS JOIN group_mean AS m
WHERE m.mean_avg_remaingb IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
